reviewer.notes: Re-derived from live probe raw files, not from harvest UNIT-COMPLETE. Probe 1 token-count retriever and probe 2 Jaccard retriever agree on every per-claim generated/baseline bit. Local-corpus generated_rate_all=0.850000 vs baseline_rate_all=0.700000. False-claim generated rate is 1.0; baseline is 0.823529. C18-C20 stay silent; the always-contradiction mutant fires on all three. Raw claim 'The Moon is made of cheese.' normalizes to subject='The Moon' without KeyError. The earlier frozen Bing RSS 0/20 vs 0/20 result is retained as a historical backend measurement; sidecars for that backend remain absent and were not faked.

defects.summary: The completed comparison covers one backend (Bing RSS); the failed DuckDuckGo attempts cannot be folded into the measurement.
Bing RSS returned generic or lexically confused results for many quoted technical queries, so the 0/20 tie may reflect backend query interpretation rather than query-family equivalence.
One analyst froze the claim labels, baseline queries, and regex adjudication before retrieval; no independent semantic adjudicator reviewed result relevance.
The C10 HashiCorp truth URL returned HTTP 308 with a 15-byte body; URL/timestamp/hash lineage is complete, but that fetched body is not substantive evidence.

The required negative control rejects an always-contradiction system but an all-silent system exactly matches all 20 observed predictions; no positive retrieval/adjudication control establishes sensitivity. RESOLVED: Local-corpus generated arm hits 17/17 false claims; the adjudicator is not all-silent.

The implemented generator requires subject, capability, competitor, and issue_repo fields and raises KeyError for a raw claim string, so the title's any-claim generality is not implemented. RESOLVED: normalize_raw_claim accepts 'The Moon is made of cheese.' and expands five queries.

Harvest packed only the primary JSON. All claimed probe/fixture sidecar paths under command-center/p2-wave/probes/RES-0147/ are absent on this tree, so named probes cannot be replayed here. RESOLVED: Named probe scripts, claims.json, corpus.json, and raw logs exist under probes/RES-0147/.

retry.policy: two strikes then pivot: after 2 failures on the same error fingerprint, enumerate >=2 alternative approaches before a third attempt
pivot_alternatives: Replay frozen Bing RSS (sidecars absent on this tree).
Build a fixed local search index and query both arms against that corpus.

residual_unknowns.claim: Whether the generated set still outperforms baseline on a live web-search backend is unknown.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: Repeat the same 20 claims and templates against a second live backend after rate limits reset, keeping the ten-result cap.

report.title: Mechanical generation of disconfirming queries for any claim
report.question_or_target: Given a claim, can disconfirming search queries be generated mechanically - negation, failure vocabulary, competitor framing, 'X does not work', issue-tracker state filters - and does the generated set surface contradictory evidence at a higher rate than an unstructured counter-search on the same 20 claims?
report.answer: YES on the local-corpus pivot; NO on the historical frozen Bing RSS run. Two independent probes agree: generated_rate_all=0.850000, baseline_rate_all=0.700000, difference=0.150000 (17/20 vs 14/20). False-claim generated rate is 1.000000 versus baseline 0.823529. The required three true claims stay silent and the always-contradiction mutant goes red. Raw claims are accepted. The earlier Bing RSS experiment remains a 0/20 vs 0/20 tie and was not reconstructed.
report.evidence_requirement_verbatim: two mechanically independent signals per load-bearing claim (rules/common/single-signal-verification.md); every claim carries source lineage (resolved URL + fetch timestamp + sha256 of the fetched bytes), a Sherman-Kent confidence band, and a named independent verification path (_USER-PROMPTS.md:10717); the comparison uses the same claims, same backends and same result budget for both arms; the rate difference is reported with the per-claim breakdown
report.tests_required_verbatim: negative control: include 3 claims that are true and well-established and confirm the generator surfaces NO contradiction for them; a generator that always finds contradiction is manufacturing it
